text: The historical GetFolder landing changes owned Cargo configuration, lockfile, dependency declaration and consumer code alongside the imported library. At the accepted endpoint the dependency uses a registry version declaration and the lock resolves ews 0.1.1; the old Git pin is gone in the scoped configuration check. Dependency edits need these owned consumers and resolution files checked together. This is an integration lesson, not an imported-library naming convention or proof that the build succeeded. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Keep owned EWS dependency integration separate from imported source style
